name: Notes and documents
summary: Reads the notes and documents in folders you choose, keeps a short summary of each, and finds them again by what they are about. It never changes your files.

requires.why: To read the folders you choose. It only ever reads; your files are never changed.
To find a file by what it is about, not only by its words.
To read PDFs and Word files. Without it, only text and Markdown files are read.

settings.label: Folders to read
settings.hint: Documents and notes in these folders are read and summarised. Each must be inside a folder you opened for Alexia; any other is left alone.

settings.label: Notes folder
settings.hint: An Obsidian vault or any folder of Markdown files. Links and #tags are kept. Apple Notes is not read here; it needs the Mac limb.

settings.label: Read again
settings.hint: How often to look for changes. Only files that changed are read again.

settings.label: Read the folders now
settings.hint: Look for changes now instead of waiting.
